The only deep-core Namdapha camp legally accessible to organised trekking groups — Embeyong Camp inside the buffer-to-core transition zone, ~25km trek from Deban. Forest Dept-managed, basic bunks, water from forest stream. Booked exclusively as part of the Namdapha Tiger Reserve multi-day trek package via the Field Director's office at Miao. The xfactor that justifies the long journey — most travellers turn back at Deban; Embeyong is where the rainforest actually starts.
signature_experience: Night transect from Embeyong with Lisu trackers — peak chance of seeing clouded leopard or Asian golden cat (Namdapha has 4 of the world's 7 cat species seen routinely from camp); pre-dawn calls from White-bellied Heron (~250 left globally).
